title: rehmannia glutinosa f. purpurea
intro: Rehmannia glutinosa f. purpurea, commonly known as Purple Rehmannia or Di Huang, is a plant-based medicinal herb that belongs to the Scrophulariaceae family. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to promote health and well-being, with notable health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, fatigue, and menstrual disorders. The therapeutic actions of Purple Rehmannia include its ability to cool the blood, nourish the yin, and tonify the kidney Qi, making it a popular ingredient in traditional Chinese herbal formulas. The bioactive constituents of Purple Rehmannia include iridoid glycosides, polysaccharides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
